Title: Wiki Validation Current State
Content: MemorySmith validation has a strong page and task baseline but still has a dedicated live-memory validation gap. `Scripts/Validate-Repo.ps1` runs solution build and tests plus `Test-TaskRecords.ps1`, `Test-PageLinks.ps1`, and `Test-PagePathLiterals.ps1`. Those checks catch task-record JSON drift, markdown link issues, and path-literal hygiene problems, and the NUnit suite exercises many wiki-backed behaviors by copying the live data into temp storage. The remaining gap is that the repository still lacks a first-class whole-corpus validator focused only on `Data/Memories` required fields, filename or id alignment, and other memory record invariants; that gap is already tracked in task TSK-0003. Operators and agents should therefore treat page-link and task-record scripts as cheap mandatory gates, but still verify live memory behavior through runtime surfaces such as `/memories`, `/chat`, `/health`, and `/api/diagnostics` when the issue could be data-shape rather than link-shape drift.
